title: Asking for Help
description:
The night they hit bottom, {name} didn't endure alone but called a gambling-recovery group.

The courage of that call comes back sometimes.

Today another shaky moment came.

choices.text: Asking for help — was the strongest choice
choices.result_text:
Trying to win alone wasn't strength. Reaching out was the real courage.

That one call turned {name} onto a different road.
Addiction was overcome not by willpower but by connection.

choices.text: Whenever shaken — I dial that number again
choices.result_text:
Recovery wasn't one resolution but a choice made each time.

{name} isn't ashamed to ask for help whenever shaken.
As long as they can dial again, they won't collapse again.

title: Telling Dad Everything
description:
When they hit bottom, {name} told Dad everything — that they'd fallen into gambling.

The weight of that confession comes back sometimes.

Today Dad carefully brought up that day.

choices.text: "Glad I told you then. Hiding it would've broken me more."
choices.result_text:
Dad was quiet for a long time.
'...Thank you for telling me. For not carrying it alone.'

That confession, made despite the shame, kept them from sinking alone.
Showing weakness to family was, in fact, the start of recovery.

choices.text: "Because you knew — I could hold on."
choices.result_text:
'That's what family is for.'

Hidden alone, they'd have sunk deeper.
{name} knows having someone to share weakness with was recovery's greatest resource.

title: Saying Just One More Hand
description:
When they hit bottom, {name} went deeper, saying 'just one more hand, I'll recoup it all.'

They know that choice's result.

Today the temptation to recoup beckons again.

choices.text: Going deeper then — made me see bottom. Never again
choices.result_text:
'Just one more hand' was the most dangerous lie.

{name} knows how far that recoup-desire dragged them.
But having seen bottom, they could also climb back up.

choices.text: That bottom — became the reason to stop
choices.result_text:
Falling deeper that day, paradoxically, stopped {name}.

Some people only change direction after hitting bottom.
That worst choice also became the last gamble.

title: Handing Over That Card
description:
To an influential person met by chance, {name} actively handed over a card and made their pitch.

That bold moment comes back sometimes.

Today came a moment of hesitating whether to seize a chance.

choices.text: Approaching boldly then — opened a door
choices.result_text:
Opportunity extends its hand only to those who approach.

Had they hesitated, that connection would have passed by.
{name} knows the nerve to step up sometimes matters more than skill.

choices.text: Connections — only matter atop my own ability
choices.result_text:
Handing over a card was just a start; what fills the rest is skill.

Rather than lean on connections, {name} focused on becoming someone worth investing in.
Connection is a bridge, but crossing it took your own feet.

title: Putting Down the Deposit
description:
At a moment of big decision, {name} put down a deposit and signed for a home.

That trembling moment comes back sometimes.

Today they look back on that decision.

choices.text: That decision — became a foothold for assets
choices.result_text:
The hand signing trembled, but that one decision made a big flow.

{name} knows the choice made after hesitation was right.
Sometimes there are moments you must decide even without perfect certainty.

choices.text: The bigger the decision — the more careful the vetting
choices.result_text:
The decision was good, but so was the risk.

{name} learned that big decisions demand more thorough vetting.
The difference between boldness and recklessness lay in the depth of vetting.

title: Choosing to Leave on Time
description:
Faced with overtime culture, {name} drew a line — 'if the work's done, I leave on time.'

That boundary comes back sometimes.

Today there's the pressure of face-saving overtime again.

choices.text: That boundary — protected my time
choices.result_text:
Only with time after work was there time for one's own goal.

{name} spent the time saved by leaving on time studying investing.
Drawing a boundary wasn't laziness, but a declaration of priorities.

choices.text: Over face-saving — I prove it with results
choices.result_text:
The work was producing results, not sitting long.

{name} decided to speak with results over hours at the desk.
To leave on time with a clear conscience, the work had to be truly done.

title: Letting It Slide
description:
Faced with a condescending boss's lecture, {name} let it slide with 'you're right.'

That tact comes back sometimes.

Today they face a similar lecture.

choices.text: Saving energy — was wise
choices.result_text:
No need to take up every fight.

{name} knows how to tell what to let slide from what to confront.
Spending energy arguing with someone who won't change was a loss.

choices.text: Let it slide — but take the usable bits
choices.result_text:
Even a kkondae's nagging sometimes mixes in real experience.

{name} let the form slide but picked out the usable content.
You may dislike the person, but no need to throw out their experience too.

title: Speaking Plainly and Proudly
description:
Before Ji-yeon's mother, {name} spoke plainly and proudly, without dressing things up.

That confidence comes back sometimes.

Today they stand in another place of being judged.

choices.text: Honesty — was the strongest weapon
choices.result_text:
Unadorned sincerity moved people more than any packaging.

{name} knows showing yourself as you are works.
Confidence came not from having much, but from believing in yourself.

choices.text: Even now — I don't dress myself up
choices.result_text:
Packaging gets exposed in the end; honesty leaves trust.

{name} decided not to inflate themselves even when judged.
Being recognized as your true self was the longest-lasting recognition.

title: Saying I'll Report You
description:
When they learned Sangchul's truth, {name} cut ties, saying 'I'll report you.'

That resolute choice comes back sometimes.

Today the weight of that decision lingers.

choices.text: I did the right thing — chose conscience over gain
choices.result_text:
Sangchul's network and information were vast, but he was the man who ruined Dad.

{name} doesn't regret choosing conscience over gain.
Some bridges must be burned to protect yourself.

choices.text: Cutting him off — I came this far on my own
choices.result_text:
The road without a mentor or network was harder, but cleaner.

{name} knows they rose on their own without Sangchul.
Going far on your own strength beat going fast on borrowed power.

title: Saying I'm Still Learning
description:
Before a holdem master, {name} said humbly, 'It's only been a while, I'm still learning.'

That humility comes back sometimes.

Today came another chance to learn from someone.

choices.text: A learning posture — made for fast growth
choices.result_text:
One who tries to learn grows faster than one who pretends to know.

{name} knows that humility was a shortcut to skill.
The key was using that learning somewhere other than gambling.

choices.text: Use that instinct — somewhere other than gambling
choices.result_text:
The ability to read odds and calculate expected value was more useful off the table.

{name} moved that instinct to investing and judgment.
The same ability, applied differently, parted lives.

title: Hearing Out the Other Position
description:
When another path opened in an interview, {name} heard it out — 'What's the position?'

That open attitude comes back sometimes.

Today they face an unexpected offer again.

choices.text: Hearing it out — widened my options
choices.result_text:
Just listening before closing the door increases your options.

{name} built the flexibility to consider even unexpected offers.
A path not in the plan was sometimes the better path.

choices.text: Listen — but check if it fits my direction
choices.result_text:
Not every offer is good. It has to fit my direction.

{name} stays open but filters by their own standards.
Widening options and being swayed were different things.

title: Reaching Out to Jaehyuk First
description:
After being scammed, {name} reached out first — 'Jaehyuk, how've you been?'

That complicated feeling comes back sometimes.

Today they think about how to settle that matter.

choices.text: Reaching out first — was to find closure
choices.result_text:
Carrying hatred takes energy too.

{name} wanted to somehow tie off that relationship.
Not forgiveness, but closure — that was for themselves.

choices.text: Now — I'm no longer bound by that matter
choices.result_text:
Tie your heart to the past and you lose the strength to go forward.

{name} left the Jaehyuk matter in the past and set their gaze ahead.
Leave the losses as losses, take the lessons — and move on.

title: Congratulating Sincerely
description:
At a thriving friend's news, {name} said, 'congratulations sincerely — I'm on my own path.'

That mature heart comes back sometimes.

Today they hear another's good news.

choices.text: I can now rejoice at others' success — without envy
choices.result_text:
Only one who accepts that another's success isn't their failure can congratulate sincerely.

{name} knows that ease comes from conviction in one's own path.
Rejoicing without envy was the sturdiest self-esteem.

choices.text: My path too — I walk it quietly
choices.result_text:
Congratulate sincerely, but my pace stays unshaken.

{name} walked their own road without being swayed by others' speed.
Knowing each has their own timetable was the way to be free of comparison.
